normalized.result: Yes, that gives me the same safety. Selecting the two, pressing Delete, and getting a confirmation that showed the count, spelled out that their notes, tags, and details would go too, and required a deliberate "Delete 2 permanently" click — that's the same careful pause I wanted for a single deletion, just applied to a batch. Good that bulk deletion never skips the confirmation. Happy with it.
